description: This file contains classes and methods for serialization and deserialization of data within the Orleans project, including generic serializers, value serializers, and object serializers, with wide-ranging overloads for different data sources and destinations.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Provides comprehensive serialization and deserialization methods for generic data types, supporting multiple data sources and destinations, as well as session management.

classes.name: Serializer<T>
classes.description: Specialized serializer for type T, with methods optimized for that specific type, including writing to buffers, streams, and over various input/output configurations.

classes.name: ValueSerializer<T>
classes.description: Serializer for value types T, optimized for high performance and minimal allocations, supporting serialization into buffers and streams.

classes.name: ObjectSerializer
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of objects with runtime-determined types, allowing for flexible object serialization scenarios.

classes.name: ObjectSerializer
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of objects with runtime-determined types, supporting multiple overloads with various data sources and sessions.

classes.name: DeepCopier
classes.description: Provides functionality for copying objects and values, managing deep copy operations through a codec provider and a copy context pool.

classes.name: DeepCopier<T>
classes.description: A generic version of DeepCopier, allowing type-specific deep copying with context management.

methods.name: SerializeToArray
methods.description: Serializes a value to a new byte array.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Various overloads to serialize a value into different destinations such as byte arrays, streams, buffers, and buffers with session context.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Various overloads to deserialize data from streams, buffers, sequences, and memory segments into a value of type T.

methods.name: CanSerialize
methods.description: Checks if a given type can be serialized by the current session pool's codec provider.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Multiple overloads to serialize an object into different destinations such as Memory<byte>, Stream, IBufferWriter<byte>, Span<byte>, or byte arrays, with optional session and size hints.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Multiple overloads to deserialize data from different sources such as Stream, ReadOnlySequence<byte>, ReadOnlySpan<byte>, byte[], ArraySegment<byte>, or ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, returning an object of the specified type.
